videos.title: New iPhone 18 Pro: Everything announced about the iPhone with the best camera and battery life ever
videos.description:
iPhone 18 Pro is purpose-built for unprecedented performance, featuring the vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip and exceptional AI capabilities. It delivers the longest battery life ever in an iPhone* — 6 more hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro Max compared with iPhone 17 Pro Max.** A new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture for improved low-light photos and videos and impressive depth of field. Available in four colors: Burgundy, Glacier, Silver, Black.

videos.title: iPhone Duo: Everything announced about the first foldable iPhone
videos.description:
iPhone Duo is the first foldable iPhone, featuring the largest display ever and reimagined iOS experiences for unprecedented versatility, including side-by-side apps for multitasking, hands-free FaceTime calls, and flexible viewing. The titanium frame and hinge cover make it beautiful and durable. With a 48MP Dual Fusion camera system, A20 Pro chip, and all-day battery, it's an iPhone unlike any iPhone.

Learn more about iPhone Duo: https://apple.co/4gVtXOl
